validation_candidates.title: Similarities and differences in the innervation of mystacial vibrissal follicle–sinus complexes in the rat and cat: A confocal microscopic study
validation_candidates.evidence: The study systematically characterized and compared the 3D sensory innervation architecture and terminal arborizations of vibrissal follicle-sinus complexes between cats and rats.

validation_candidates.title: NMDA Receptors Mediate Olfactory Learning and Memory in Drosophila
validation_candidates.evidence: The study addressed the acute role of NMDA receptors in adult associative learning and long-term memory in Drosophila.

validation_candidates.title: A Map of Olfactory Representation in the Drosophila Mushroom Body
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors mapped the spatial representation of antennal lobe projection neuron inputs and Kenyon cell dendritic organization in the mushroom body calyx of Drosophila.

validation_candidates.title: Tissue optical immersion clearing
validation_candidates.evidence: The article is a review discussing optical immersion clearing mechanisms, agents, and biomedical applications.

validation_candidates.title: Aging Specifically Impairs amnesiac-Dependent Memory in Drosophila
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors studied the biological mechanism of age-related memory impairment in Drosophila, finding that it is mediated by a specific decay in amnesiac-dependent middle-term memory.

validation_candidates.title: Visualizing Long-Term Memory Formation in Two Neurons of the Drosophila Brain
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors identified and visualized de novo protein synthesis and circuit dynamics during long-term memory formation within two dorsal-anterior-lateral (DAL) neurons in the Drosophila brain.

validation_candidates.title: Standardized atlas of the brain of the desert locust, Schistocerca gregaria
validation_candidates.evidence: The paper focuses on establishing and standardizing a 3D reference brain atlas of the desert locust by reconstructing neuropils from whole-mount brains.

validation_candidates.title: Neural substrates of memory: From synapse to system
validation_candidates.evidence: The paper is a review providing a unifying perspective on the biological substrates of memory from synapse to systems in Drosophila.

validation_candidates.title: Recent progress in tissue optical clearing for spectroscopic application
validation_candidates.journal: Spectrochim Acta A Mol Biomol Spectrosc
validation_candidates.evidence: This is a review paper evaluating recent developments in optical clearing for spectroscopic applications.

validation_candidates.title: Octopamine Neuromodulatory Effects on a Social Behavior Decision-Making Network in Drosophila Males
validation_candidates.evidence: The study investigated how octopaminergic neurons modulate courtship and aggression decision-making behaviors in male Drosophila, including structural tracing of single Fru(M)-positive OA SOG neurons.

validation_candidates.title: Insect NMDA receptors mediate juvenile hormone biosynthesis
validation_candidates.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors demonstrated the existence and physiological role of functional NMDA receptors in regulating juvenile hormone biosynthesis in insect corpora allata.

validation_candidates.title: High-resolution confocal imaging and three-dimensional rendering
validation_candidates.evidence: This publication provides a methodological review/overview describing technical advances in FocusClear optical clearing and confocal imaging of thick biological tissues.

validation_candidates.title: High-resolution ultramicroscopy of the developing and adult nervous system in optically cleared Drosophila melanogaster
validation_candidates.evidence: The paper focuses on developing FlyClear and an ultramicroscopy imaging setup to demonstrate clearing and imaging of intact Drosophila across developmental stages.

validation_candidates.title: Standard three-dimensional glomeruli of the Manduca转化 antennal lobe: a tool to study both developmental and adult neuronal plasticity
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors investigated developmental and odor-induced neuronal plasticity by analyzing glomerulus volume changes in the Manduca sexta antennal lobe across developmental and adult time points.

validation_candidates.title: Direct injection of venom by a predatory wasp into cockroach brain
validation_candidates.evidence: The study demonstrated the direct delivery of venom by the parasitoid wasp Ampulex compressa specifically into target ganglia in the head of its cockroach prey.

validation_candidates.title: Ultrastructure of pigment-dispersing hormone-immunoreactive neurons in a three-dimensional model of the accessory medulla of the cockroach Leucophaea maderae
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors analyzed the synaptic connectivity and morphology of pigment-dispersing hormone-immunoreactive neurons in the circadian pacemaker center (accessory medulla) of the cockroach.

validation_candidates.title: Digital, three-dimensional average shaped atlas of the heliothis virescens brain with integrated gustatory and olfactory neurons
validation_candidates.evidence: The study focuses on generating and evaluating a digital, standardized 3D average-shaped atlas of the Heliothis virescens brain and demonstrating the integration of stained neurons.

validation_candidates.title: Implementation of pigment‐dispersing factor‐immunoreactive neurons in a standardized atlas of the brain of the cockroachLeucophaea maderae
validation_candidates.evidence: The article describes the generation of a standardized 3D brain atlas of the cockroach to map the circadian pacemaker system.

validation_candidates.title: Development of cricket mushroom bodies
validation_candidates.evidence: The authors investigated the neurogenesis and developmental origin of Kenyon cells in cricket mushroom bodies from embryogenesis through adulthood.

real_world_application_papers.title: Anchorene is a carotenoid-derived regulatory metabolite required for anchor root formation in Arabidopsis.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Applied TDE clearing to investigate the cellular origin and developmental progression of anchor roots triggered by anchorene in Arabidopsis.

real_world_application_papers.title: Arabidopsis UMAMIT24 and 25 are amino acid exporters involved in seed loading.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Used TDE clearing to observe cellular expression and mutant seed development, demonstrating UMAMIT24/25 function in seed amino acid loading.

real_world_application_papers.title: Constitutive signaling activity of a receptor-associated protein links fertilization with embryonic patterning in Arabidopsis thaliana.
real_world_application_papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Used TDE optical clearing to analyze zygote and early embryo development to show how SSP constitutively activates YDA signaling in Arabidopsis.

real_world_application_papers.title: Concerted Action of Evolutionarily Ancient and Novel SNARE Complexes in Flowering-Plant Cytokinesis.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Employed TDE optical clearing to evaluate cytokinesis defects and endosperm cellularization in Arabidopsis knolle and syp132 mutant embryos.

real_world_application_papers.title: Local endoreduplication as a feature of intracellular fungal accommodation in arbuscular mycorrhizas.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Employed TDE clearing for 3D confocal imaging of Medicago truncatula root cortical cells to uncover local endoreduplication during arbuscular mycorrhizal colonization.

real_world_application_papers.title: Gibberellins negatively regulate the development of Medicago truncatula root system.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Used TDE optical clearing to image cortical cell layers and evaluate root apical meristem size changes under gibberellin treatment in Medicago truncatula.

real_world_application_papers.title: Cadmium affects cell niches maintenance in Arabidopsis thaliana post-embryonic shoot and root apical meristem by altering the expression of WUS/WOX homolog genes and cytokinin accumulation.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Applied TDE clearing to image morphological alterations and WOX reporter expression in Arabidopsis root and shoot apical meristems under cadmium toxicity.

real_world_application_papers.title: Metaphloem development in the Arabidopsis root tip.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Applied TDE clearing in the TetSee protocol to track metaphloem sieve element specification and elongation dynamics in Arabidopsis root tips.

real_world_application_papers.title: Seed coat development in explosively dispersed seeds of Cardamine hirsuta.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Used TDE optical clearing to observe integument cellular differentiation and pectin-rich cell wall modifications during Cardamine hirsuta seed coat development.

real_world_application_papers.title: FLOWERING REPRESSOR AAA(+) ATPase 1 is a novel regulator of perennial flowering in Arabis alpina.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Applied TDE clearing to observe AaFRAT1 reporter localization in leaf primordia and shoot apical meristems of Arabis alpina.

real_world_application_papers.title: CsWRKY29, a key transcription factor in tea plant for freezing tolerance, ABA sensitivity, and sugar metabolism.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Used optical clearing to assess cellular and physiological freezing tolerance phenotypes in Arabidopsis leaves overexpressing CsWRKY29.

real_world_application_papers.title: Auxin response factor 10 insensitive to miR160regulation induces apospory-like phenotypes in Arabidopsis.
real_world_application_papers.evidence: Employed TDE optical clearing to observe supernumerary functional megaspores and apospory-like ovule phenotypes in Arabidopsis mARF10 lines.

validation_candidates.title: ACT-PRESTO: Rapid and consistent tissue clearing and labeling method for 3-dimensional (3D) imaging.
validation_candidates.evidence: Presents the ACT-PRESTO technique for rapid tissue clearing and pressure-assisted immunolabeling.

validation_candidates.title: Next generation histology methods for three-dimensional imaging of fresh and archival human brain tissues.
validation_candidates.evidence: The study presents OPTIClear, a tissue clearing solution developed for fresh and archival human brain tissue.

validation_candidates.title: Whole-Brain Vasculature Reconstruction at the Single Capillary Level.
validation_candidates.evidence: The paper presents a vascular staining and clearing approach combining CLARITY and light-sheet microscopy for whole-brain vessel reconstruction.

validation_candidates.title: Developing 3D microscopy with CLARITY on human brain tissue: Towards a tool for informing and validating MRI-based histology.
validation_candidates.evidence: The study adapts CLARITY tissue clearing and 3D optical microscopy for validating MRI-based microstructure estimates in human brain tissue.

validation_candidates.title: ClearSeeAlpha: Advanced Optical Clearing for Whole-Plant Imaging.
